title: The Map of Nowhere
text: A map lies on the ground in the dark, unrolled, weighted at the corners with stones. It shows exactly where you stand, down to the stones. It also shows a road running off into the black, clear and well marked, a road that is not there.

options.label: Follow the road that is not there, and trust the map that knows where you stand.

outcomes.text: It is there when you walk it, and it is short.
It leads somewhere else entirely, and the map does not show the way back.

options.label: The wisest studies whose hand drew it, and how it knew.

outcomes.text: Your own hand, years from now. The ink is not yet dry.

options.label: Burn the map, before it leads anyone else astray.

outcomes.text: The ash spells a word you do not know, and something far off loses its way.
